w_shiv.name: Shiv
w_shiv.desc: A sharpened strip of Cistern hull plating, cloth-wrapped grip.

w_pipe.name: Lead Pipe
w_pipe.desc: Heavy, honest, and not going to break.

w_machete.name: Machete
w_machete.desc: A field blade with a chipped edge and a good balance.

w_spear.name: Rebar Spear
w_spear.desc: Rebar ground to a point and lashed to a pole. Reaches two tiles.

w_knuckles.name: Bolt Knuckles
w_knuckles.desc: Four hex bolts welded to a steel band.

w_frag.name: Can Grenade
w_frag.desc: A tin can packed with powder and nails. Short fuse.

w_knife_throw.name: Throwing Spikes
w_knife_throw.desc: Balanced steel spikes. Retrievable if you survive.

w_zip38.name: Zip Pistol
w_zip38.desc: A single-shot pipe gun firing .38. Ugly and loud.

w_revolver38.name: Six-Shooter
w_revolver38.desc: A pre-Burn .38 revolver, refinished more times than anyone remembers.

w_pistol9.name: Service Pistol
w_pistol9.desc: A 9mm semi-automatic from some long-gone police force.

w_hand44.name: Hand Cannon
w_hand44.desc: A .44 that kicks like a mule. People listen when it talks.

w_smg9.name: Stutter Gun
w_smg9.desc: A stamped-steel 9mm machine pistol. Bursts only, really.

w_sawnoff.name: Sawn-Off
w_sawnoff.desc: Double-barrelled 12 gauge, cut down for close quarters.

w_pump.name: Pump Shotgun
w_pump.desc: A farm gun. Reliable in sand, which matters here.

w_bolt308.name: Bolt Rifle
w_bolt308.desc: A .308 hunting rifle with a cracked but serviceable scope.

w_carbine556.name: Patrol Carbine
w_carbine556.desc: A 5.56 carbine with a folding stock and a bad history.

w_arc_pistol.name: Arc Pistol
w_arc_pistol.desc: A pre-Burn security sidearm. It hums. It should not still work.

w_sabre.name: Duelling Sabre
w_sabre.desc: A Crown blade: light, curved, a basket hilt with a house crest filed off. Made for one other person at a time.

a_9mm_hp.name: 9mm Hollowpoint
a_9mm_hp.desc: Expands in soft targets; poor against armour.

a_12ga_slug.name: 12ga Slugs
a_12ga_slug.desc: Solid slugs. Less spread, more punch through plates.

a_556_ap.name: 5.56 Penetrator
a_556_ap.desc: Steel-cored. Rare. Worth it against plate.

a_cell.name: Arc Cell
a_cell.desc: A pre-Burn charge cell. Each one fires a single shot.

r_jumpsuit.name: Cistern Issue
r_jumpsuit.desc: Grey-green work trousers, a shirt with a stencilled "9" at the shoulder, boots resoled twice. Barely armour.

r_duster.name: Leather Duster
r_duster.desc: Long coat of cured hide. Turns a knife, mostly.

r_scrap.name: Scrap Plate
r_scrap.desc: Road signs and hubcaps bolted to a harness. Loud.

r_riot.name: Riot Vest
r_riot.desc: Pre-Burn police body armour, faded insignia picked off.

r_hood.name: Dust Hood
r_hood.desc: Wrapped cloth and goggles against the grit.

r_gasmask.name: Filter Mask
r_gasmask.desc: A rubber mask with a screw-in filter. Breathe easy in bad air.

r_velvet.name: The Velvet's Evening
r_velvet.desc: Evening clothes cut by the Madame of the Velvet to the Crown's season: bottle-green, Crown-plain, nothing on them that says the Row. They check whether you look like you belong. This is what belonging looks like.

c_knitkit.name: Knit-Kit
c_knitkit.desc: A syringe of clotting gel and fast-acting regenerant. Pre-Burn formula, post-Burn quality.

c_bandage.name: Boiled Bandage
c_bandage.desc: Clean-ish strips of cloth. Better than bleeding.

c_splint.name: Splint Kit
c_splint.desc: Rods and wraps to set a broken limb.

c_radflush.name: Flush
c_radflush.desc: A bitter purgative that drags radiation out of you. And everything else.

c_kick.name: Kick
c_kick.desc: A paper twist of grey powder. Snorted, it makes the world slow down.

c_stillwater.name: Stillwater
c_stillwater.desc: A Choir-brewed tincture. Steadies the hands and quiets the mind.

c_bitters.name: Rot Bitters
c_bitters.desc: Home-distilled spirit. Courage in a jar; aim not included.

c_water.name: Clean Water
c_water.desc: A capped bottle of filtered water.

c_meat.name: Raw Meat
c_meat.desc: Hare, mostly, or something slower. Cook it at a fire; raw, it is a bad night.

c_fruit.name: Orchard Fruit
c_fruit.desc: Small, hard, sour, and the first thing you have eaten that grew on a tree. The Choir grows them in the burnt rows north of Shale.

c_jerky.name: Lizard Jerky
c_jerky.desc: Salted, smoked, chewy as a boot.

c_algae.name: Algae Cake
c_algae.desc: Cistern hydroponic ration. Green, dense, nutritious, joyless.

c_tin.name: Pre-Burn Tin
c_tin.desc: An unlabelled tin. Could be peaches. Could be anything.

tolls.name: Tolls
tolls.desc: Stamped tin chits issued by the Tollmen. Good anywhere the roads go.

u_holdfast.name: Holdfast
u_holdfast.desc: Grey tablets that keep flesh and implant on speaking terms. Menders sell them by the strip.

u_powercell.name: Implant Cell
u_powercell.desc: A thumb-sized charge cell for chrome that draws more than a body makes.

j_wiring.name: Copper Wiring
j_wiring.desc: Stripped from walls and dead machines.

j_hide.name: Hide
j_hide.desc: A hare's, or something's. Scraped and salted. Someone with a needle will want it.

j_electronics.name: Circuit Board
j_electronics.desc: Pre-Burn electronics. Someone always wants these.

j_fuel.name: Fuel Can
j_fuel.desc: A dented can, a third full.

j_powder.name: Black Powder
j_powder.desc: For hand-loading, or for bad ideas.

t_picks.name: Lock Picks
t_picks.desc: A ring of tension wrenches and hooks. +15 Security while carried.

t_repair.name: Repair Kit
t_repair.desc: Files, wire, glue and patience. Restores weapon or armour condition.

t_docbag.name: Doctor's Bag
t_docbag.desc: Scalpels, sutures, a battered stethoscope. +15 Medicine when treating wounds.

t_lamp.name: Hand Lamp
t_lamp.desc: A wind-up flashlight. Reduces darkness penalties.

k_photo.name: Photograph
k_photo.desc: A creased print: you, older, in a ruined city of towers. On the back, a date forty-one years gone.

k_mask.name: Stranger's Dust Mask
k_mask.desc: Leather and tin, sun-split: a dust mask for the salt wind, worn to his shape. On the brow, painted with care, half a sun, or an open hand.

k_notebook.name: Stranger's Notebook
k_notebook.desc: Pages of tight marks that are not quite letters. Some are crossed out with care.

k_ring.name: Worn Ring
k_ring.desc: A plain band, worn thin on the inside. Two letters and a half-sun mark, almost gone.

k_map.name: The Stranger's Map
k_map.desc: Soft as cloth from handling. A drawn line of road, twelve places pricked with a pin, and beside each a block of five marks in the stranger's cipher.

k_cipher_key.name: Tollmen Cipher Wheel
k_cipher_key.desc: Two brass discs on a rivet, letters on both rims. The Tollmen sell them to anyone who can pay, which tells you who writes the ciphers.

k_notebook_page.name: Torn Notebook Page
k_notebook_page.desc: A leaf from the stranger's notebook, in the same tight marks, creased from a scout's hood.

k_door_order.name: Council Order
k_door_order.desc: Elder Halloran's seal on a slip of ration paper: "Open the great door for the bearer."

k_seed_case.name: Cistern Seed Case
k_seed_case.desc: A sealed steel case the size of a loaf, cold to the touch, with a Cistern inventory label: VIABLE — TOMATO, BEAN, SQUASH, MILLET — DO NOT OPEN BELOW 4°C. Ninety years of somebody's patience.

k_mags_books.name: The Dry Well's Books
k_mags_books.desc: Two ledgers tied with a bootlace. Water in, water out, rooms, Dust, debts. Mags's hand throughout, and another hand in the margins of the second.

k_bram_letter.name: Bram's Letter
k_bram_letter.desc: Folded four times and sealed with machine grease. On the outside, in a mechanic's careful capitals: EDDA VALE, SHALE. He asked you not to read it, and you have not.

k_hesper_reply.name: Hesper's Reply
k_hesper_reply.desc: A single sheet in a tight, plain hand. For Bram, at the Cistern: the truth, kindly put.

k_hesper_reply_forged.name: A Reply for Bram
k_hesper_reply_forged.desc: A single sheet in a hand that is not Edda Vale's, saying things Edda Vale would have said. You wrote it.

k_pass_forged.name: Tollmen Pass (forged)
k_pass_forged.desc: A guild transit pass on the right paper with the wrong hand. Good at a glance; bad under a lamp.

k_pass_stamped.name: Tollmen Pass
k_pass_stamped.desc: A guild transit pass, stamped at Tollhouse 9. "Bearer and goods. As per."

k_packet.name: Sealed Guild Packet
k_packet.desc: Oilcloth, wax, the guild's half-moon pressed into it. For the Exchange at Ninebridge, by hand, unopened. It weighs almost nothing and you keep checking it.

k_station_key.name: Brass Station Key
k_station_key.desc: Worn to gold where a thumb rubbed it for sixty years. It opens a door at the east end of a pump hall, painted with a 4.

k_pumpman_diary.name: Pump Man's Diary
k_pumpman_diary.desc: Forty years of gauge readings in a hand that gets smaller, and on the first page, underlined twice, a credential: MAINT AUTH — MARR — DW4 — "ELEVEN".

k_hound_controller.name: Controller
k_hound_controller.desc: A grey slab the size of a hand with one lens and no buttons, warm when nothing is. The convoy was carrying it; the thing on the pan sat down beside it.

k_convoy_manifest.name: Convoy Manifest
k_convoy_manifest.desc: Guild paper. Eight crates of parts, two of water, one item listed as HANDLER (1) — CONCERN CUSTOMS SEAL — DO NOT POWER.

k_dog_plate.name: Rust Dog Plate (small)
k_dog_plate.desc: A thumb-sized scrap of plate with a dog's head scratched on it, on a child's cord. Dropped in the orchard wall.

k_ledger_page.name: Toll Ledger Page
k_ledger_page.desc: Torn from the Tollhouse 9 ledger. A line of outriders' pay: two riders, four days, "one traveller, westbound, confirmed — as per Factor Pike, post nine-west".

k_futures_paper.name: Sealed Futures Sheet
k_futures_paper.desc: Guild paper, folded and wax-sealed with the half-moon. On the outside a lot number, a place and a date; inside, the Exchange says, what will happen there. People pay for these. People pay more for them unopened.

k_strike_sheet.name: Futures Sheet — the Porters
k_strike_sheet.desc: A guild forecast, seal broken: NINEBRIDGE — PORTERS' STOPPAGE — ENDS THIRD DAY, STRAPS ON, TERMS UNCHANGED. Dated the day before the strike began.

k_exchange_line.name: Copied Ledger Line
k_exchange_line.desc: A line copied from the Exchange ledgers in your own hand: PROTECTION — TOLLHOUSE 9 — TWO RIDERS, FOUR DAYS — "WESTBOUND TRAVELLER, CONFIRMED" — PAID FROM THE SARR ACCOUNT, BY ORDER OF THE FLOOR.

k_sable_contract.name: Debt Contract — Lot Four
k_sable_contract.desc: A guild debt contract, bearer-held. SABLE CALLOWAY, 19, SUM OUTSTANDING 58 TOLLS AND INTEREST, SERVICE UNTIL CLEARED. Whoever holds this paper holds her.

k_berth_token.name: Berth Token
k_berth_token.desc: A brass tag on a wire: SPAN — BERTH A. Lazlo's, and now yours, for as long as you keep paying nothing.

k_tobias_sheet.name: Futures Sheet — Openfield
k_tobias_sheet.desc: Guild paper, seal broken long ago and the fold worn soft: OPENFIELD — HARVEST ABOVE PLAN — THE LONG NIGHT — BURNS. No date. The hand too even to be a hand. Somebody has read it a hundred times.

k_mason_letter.name: The Elder's Letter
k_mason_letter.desc: To Sister Calla at Shale, unsent: the blight, the guild's offer for the harvest, and a line crossed out so hard the pen went through the paper.

k_sky_token.name: A Cairn Stone
k_sky_token.desc: A fist of glass-crust from the burial ground, warm from your hand. The Choir gives one to whoever raises a cairn there. It is not a likeness of anyone.

k_chaff.name: Dead Seed
k_chaff.desc: A pouch of last year's seed, boiled and dried: looks right, weighs right, grows nothing. Doria calls it chaff with manners.

k_sp_pay_ledger.name: Runner's Pay Ledger
k_sp_pay_ledger.desc: Guild paper in a runner's hand: SUMP — TUNNEL — PER FOOT — WEST RIM (GREL) / EAST RIM (TANNER) — PAID FOURTH DAY — AS PER FACTOR PIKE, POST NINE-WEST. Two columns, one purse, forty feet a week each.

k_c4_order.name: Relocation Order — Cistern 4
k_c4_order.desc: City paper, the Ledger's seal: CONTINUITY RESERVE 4 — RELOCATE POPULATION TO PRECINCT — SCHEDULE R0+2 — SUPPLY NETWORK 4 TO BE RETIRED ON COMPLIANCE. Under it, in a caretaker's even print: DOOR — FAILED. SUPPLY — RETIRED. VARIANCE — TOTAL.

k_c4_diary.name: Cistern 4 Diary
k_c4_diary.desc: A clinic ledger used as a diary, in a doctor's hand that stays neat to the end. The last entry is addressed, carefully, TO WHOEVER COMES FROM MERIDIAN.

k_c4_photo.name: A Family, Cistern 4
k_c4_photo.desc: A real photograph, grain and all: a man in a pump-hand's coat, a woman, a girl of nine with a brass key on a cord. On the back: MARR. FOUR. THE DAY THE DOOR WAS TO OPEN.

k_md_papers.name: Citizen Papers — Precinct
k_md_papers.desc: A card under plastic with the Ledger's seal, your face printed small and grey, a number, and a line: CITIZEN — PRECINCT — ENTRY AND RESIDENCE. It is the first document that has ever called you anything.

k_md_pass.name: Provisional Pass — 3 Days
k_md_pass.desc: A paper slip with a stamp: PROVISIONAL — PRECINCT ONLY — HEARING PENDING. Three days, it says. Nobody at the gate has ever enforced the three.

k_md_fine_notice.name: Notice of Fines
k_md_fine_notice.desc: Ledger paper: FINES OUTSTANDING — 3. CURFEW (FORECAST R30.6). LOITERING, AVENUE (FORECAST R30.6). UNLICENSED ASSEMBLY (FORECAST R30.7). TOTAL 45. Fined, in advance, for three things the city is sure you will do.

k_md_receipt.name: Fine Receipt
k_md_receipt.desc: PAID — 45 — FORECAST OFFENCES (3). The clerk stamped it twice, as if the second stamp made it make sense.

k_md_papers_forged.name: Citizen Papers (Sato's)
k_md_papers_forged.desc: A card under plastic with a seal that is very nearly the Ledger's, a face that is very nearly yours, and a number that belongs to someone who died in the Sink two springs ago. Good at a glance; the lens is another matter.

k_gig_case.name: Sealed Case (the Broker's)
k_gig_case.desc: A flat steel case, locked, light. For the clerk at the Exchange in Ninebridge, the board says, and nobody else. It ticks very faintly if you hold it to your ear, which you should not.

k_gig_letter.name: A Letter for the Captain
k_gig_letter.desc: Folded, sealed with wax that is not any guild's. For Captain Lowe, Precinct wardens, by hand. The Broker's board calls it a letter. It is the weight of a letter with something flat inside.

k_gig_lot7.name: Debt Contract — Lot Seven
k_gig_lot7.desc: A guild debt contract, bearer-held: a mechanic, forty-eight, sum outstanding 44 Tolls. The Broker wants it; the Broker did not say why, which with the Broker is the whole of an explanation.

k_odile_note.name: Odile's Note
k_odile_note.desc: Three lines in a trader's hand: the notation on the stranger's map, with the cipher's spine written out plain. "Two a night, my dear. Any more and the eyes go."

k_sk_schedule.name: Relief Pumping Schedule
k_sk_schedule.desc: A Precinct form, stamped: the Sink's three relief pumps, their hours, and the spring line through two of them — DIVERTED TO PRECINCT SUPPLY, AS PER PLAN, with a clause number. Somebody has pencilled the water line beside each week.

k_sk_variance.name: Variance — Relief Pumping
k_sk_variance.desc: A variance to the spring schedule under clause 14, the drains being the city's first duty: relief pumping to continue in the Sink; Precinct supply to bear the shortfall. Stamped by an assessor's plate, countersigned where a captain signs.

k_sk_leave.name: Keeper's Leave
k_sk_leave.desc: A torn corner of the pump log in Dagny Roos's hand: *Bearer may enter the house. The wardens may argue with me.*

k_sk_heart.name: A Heart, Chilled
k_sk_heart.desc: A steel cooler the size of a lunch tin, packed with ice that is already water at the corners. Inside, in a bag, a human heart. There is a number inked on the bag and the number has been crossed out.

k_lr_reel.name: Reverie Reel — Evidence
k_lr_reel.desc: A recording reel in a warden's evidence sleeve, the tag torn off and a Rustmouth's thumbprint over the tear. A season old. A man's last day in the city, start to end, keyed to the Lantern's cots.

k_lr_token.name: Pit Token
k_lr_token.desc: A brass token stamped with Lantern Row's pit and the word STANDING. The Skirts' pits honour it, Mab says, and the Crown's, if you ever stand in one of those.

k_masque_chit.name: Masque Chit — House Lorne
k_masque_chit.desc: A paper chit, Crown-printed: HOUSE LORNE — ONE GUEST — THE MASQUE. Lost at a Dust table by a boy who wanted to feel something, and found, as everything on the Row is, in a cage.

k_st_key.name: Key — 9-14
k_st_key.desc: A brass key on a string, worn to gold at the bow. Block Seven, floor nine, flat fourteen. The stove draws if you open the window first.

k_st_tank_log.name: The Tank Keeper's Log (copy)
k_st_tank_log.desc: Three years of nights in Oskar Vey's careful hand, copied: FILL 23–05. TWELVE PUMP 02–05, FULL DRAW. NINE: RESIDUE. The beds' depth in fingers, going to none.

k_st_ledger.name: The Trays' Ledger
k_st_ledger.desc: What the Twelves' deck grows and who eats it: sixty names, a crop a week, a third of every crop crated for a man called Latch. The last page is a form with a company's mark and a line about who owns the deck.

k_latch_card.name: A Plain Card
k_latch_card.desc: Plain card, a number, nothing else. Show it at the Docks, the man said, when you want work that pays in Crown coin. Nobody has to decide anything today.

k_bw_toll_ledger.name: The Toll Box Ledger
k_bw_toll_ledger.desc: A Rustmouth hand, five a line, five hundred lines, and a warden's stamp on the cover from the one time the Precinct wanted a count. It says what the chain takes and what the Crown is told, and the two columns do not agree.

k_bw_haul.name: Haul Ticket
k_bw_haul.desc: A strip of tin with a nail-scratched weight on it: an engine, two axles, a door and a heap. Petrov's mark. Honest, the Hand would say.

k_bw_dog_mark.name: The Dogs' Mark
k_bw_dog_mark.desc: A strip of cloth with a dog's head burned into it, old, from a cache under a bench in a garage in Bridgeward. The Rust Dogs wore it when they were a crew and not a gang.

k_cr_service_pass.name: Service Lift Pass
k_cr_service_pass.desc: A kitchen pass for the Crown's service lift, Crown-printed, STAFF — MASQUE SEASON, with a thumb-smudge where a name was. The Broker's. It opens the lift and the lens does not look at the help.

k_cr_vial.name: A Small Vial
k_cr_vial.desc: Glass, a cork, a finger of something clear. The steward said a cup, at the toast, and that nobody up there asks what was in a cup.

k_cr_reel.name: Reverie Reel — the Board
k_cr_reel.desc: A reel in a House Vane sleeve: a sitting, this season, recorded as art. Whoever sat for it did not know the room was listening.

k_cr_render.name: A Print from the Studio
k_cr_render.desc: A portrait off the Crown's renderer: you, on the steps of a restored tower, in a sash. No grain. The same dust mote twice. You have seen this picture before, in a dead man's coat.

k_cr_render_vane.name: A Print — House Vane
k_cr_render_vane.desc: A portrait off the Crown's renderer: Celestine Vane in the Committee's Chair, this season, with the vote not yet taken. The file has an opinion.

ci_ch_eye_scope.name: Scope Eye (boxed)
ci_ch_eye_scope.desc: A salvaged military optic. Finds the gap in any armour and the tremble in any hand. Pre-Burn, in its own case. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_eye_heat.name: Ember Eyes (boxed)
ci_ch_eye_heat.desc: Mender-built thermal lenses. Bodies glow through thin walls; the world looks like a fever. Mender-built, in a cloth. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_eye_concern.name: Clearsight (boxed)
ci_ch_eye_concern.desc: Concern optics: perfect vision, face recognition, a quiet overlay of names and debts. Concern work, sealed and tagged. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_neural_reflex.name: Kick Wiring (boxed)
ci_ch_neural_reflex.desc: Reflex boosters spliced into the spine’s top. Time stutters; you do not. Mender-built, in a cloth. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_neural_link.name: Gridjack (boxed)
ci_ch_neural_link.desc: A neural port and interface. In a city, the grid answers when you think at it. Pre-Burn, in its own case. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_arm_breaker.name: Breaker Arm (boxed)
ci_ch_arm_breaker.desc: A hydraulic forearm. Doors, plating and bones are all just resistance. Mender-built, in a cloth. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_arm_steady.name: Gyro Hand (boxed)
ci_ch_arm_steady.desc: A stabilised pre-Burn surgical hand. Never shakes, never tires. Pre-Burn, in its own case. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_legs_spring.name: Spring Legs (boxed)
ci_ch_legs_spring.desc: Sprung shins and reinforced knees. Rooftops are just another floor. Mender-built, in a cloth. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_legs_strider.name: Strider Frames (boxed)
ci_ch_legs_strider.desc: Concern carbon frames. Carry a mule’s load; walk all day. Concern work, sealed and tagged. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_spine_load.name: Loadbearer Spine (boxed)
ci_ch_spine_load.desc: A braced spine from a dead labour gang. Heavy weapons stop being heavy. Pre-Burn, in its own case. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_skin_plate.name: Subdermal Plate (boxed)
ci_ch_skin_plate.desc: Ceramic scales under the skin. Shows at the knuckles and collarbones. Mender-built, in a cloth. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_skin_weave.name: Silkweave (boxed)
ci_ch_skin_weave.desc: Concern dermal mesh: stops a knife, passes for perfect skin. Concern work, sealed and tagged. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_org_lungs.name: Filter Lungs (boxed)
ci_ch_org_lungs.desc: Scrubber lungs. Dust storms, spores and gas are just weather. Pre-Burn, in its own case. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_org_heart.name: Second Heart (boxed)
ci_ch_org_heart.desc: A backup pump that kicks when the first one stops. Once. Mender-built, in a cloth. A surgeon can fit it.

ci_ch_org_voice.name: Echo Larynx (boxed)
ci_ch_org_voice.desc: A voice box that can wear anyone’s voice it has heard long enough. Concern work, sealed and tagged. A surgeon can fit it.
